title: Iodine-mediated synthesis of indolyl-1,3,4-thiadiazole amine derivatives and their DFT analysis
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,15108-15115
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02026C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Vartika Vaishya, Manish K. Mehra, S. K. Pandey, Meenakshi Pilania
This study reports a metal-free, three-component synthesis of substituted indolyl-1,3,4-thiadiazole amines, their functionalization into diverse N-heterocycles, and theoretical evaluation via DFT analysis.
